name: benchmarks
description: Workspace root for the vlt package manager benchmarks. Workspace membership and dependency catalogs live in vlt.json, not here.

scripts.dev:build: vlt run --workspace=apps/data build && vlt run --workspace=apps/www build
scripts.dev: vlt run dev:prebuild && vlt run dev:build && vlt run --workspace-group=apps dev
scripts.wipe: vlt query ':root, :workspace' --view=json | jq -r '.[].to.location + "/node_modules"' | sort -u | xargs -n1 rm -rf --
